meta.rawHtml:
<button
    class="relative border border-2 border-teal-600 rounded px-4 py-2 inline cursor-pointer text-4xl font-bold before:bg-teal-600 hover:rounded-b-none before:absolute before:-bottom-0 before:-left-0  before:block before:h-[4px] before:w-full before:origin-bottom-right before:scale-x-0 before:transition before:duration-300 before:ease-in-out hover:before:origin-bottom-left hover:before:scale-x-100">
    Hover me
</button>
